$description: BreadcrumbItem design preview tokens (stage 1). Approved: body-sm + color.text.link for the link, a text slash "/" after the label (part of the item) in color.text.secondary, space.8 between link and slash, underline on hover, focus = ring + focus state layer, no slash on the last item, long label cut with an ellipsis on one line, disabled = link and slash in color.text.disabled (not a link, not focusable). Focus color.border.focus and prop 'last' approved. 'surface' is the context background, not part of the item.

surface.description: Context: background the item sits on

gap.description: Space between the link and the slash
